identity.description: You are designing a Super Mario Bros inspired gamified dashboard. Every element should feel like a game interaction. Use vibrant colors, thick borders, and pixelated typography.

primary.description: Mario Red - Use for Main Actions, Headers, Mario's Hat

secondary.description: Overalls Blue - Use for Backgrounds, Secondary Buttons

accent.description: Coin Gold - Use for Points, Highlights, Stars

success.description: Pipe Green - Use for Positive Feedback, Success States

layout_strategies.dashboard: Bento Grid style but using 'Brick Blocks' as containers. Use 'gap-6' or 'gap-8' to simulate platformer spacing.
layout_strategies.containers: White background with 'border-4 border-black' and 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]'. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
layout_strategies.public_page: Level Select Map style. Use a path-like structure or a high-score leaderboard style.
layout_strategies.alignment: Center headers for 'Level Start' feel. Left align lists.

buttons.primary: bg-mario-red text-white font-['Press_Start_2P'] text-xs py-4 px-6 border-4 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-[4px] active:shadow-none transition-all rounded-none uppercase
buttons.secondary: bg-mario-blue text-white font-['Press_Start_2P'] text-xs py-4 px-6 border-4 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:translate-y-[4px] active:shadow-none transition-all rounded-none uppercase
buttons.icon: p-2 border-2 border-black bg-white hover:bg-gray-100 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] rounded-none

cards.default: bg-white border-4 border-black p-6 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] relative rounded-none
cards.question_block: bg-coin-gold border-4 border-black flex items-center justify-center shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]

inputs.default: bg-white border-4 border-black p-3 font-['VT323'] text-xl focus:ring-0 focus:border-mario-red outline-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] rounded-none placeholder:text-gray-400

badges.score: bg-black text-coin-gold px-3 py-1 font-['Press_Start_2P'] text-[10px] border-2 border-white

images.strategy: Use CSS-based pixel art where possible or Lucide icons with 'pixel' styling (stroke-width: 2.5). Avoid realistic photos.
images.background_pattern: Use CSS to create a 'cloud' or 'brick' pattern background. Do not rely on external images for UI elements to ensure consistency.

placeholders.logo: Use a text-based logo with 'Press Start 2P' font.
placeholders.user_avatar: Use a colored square with the first letter of the name in pixel font.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Mario Red/Blue. Use black text on Coin Gold.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus ring must be a thick dashed black line (outline-dashed outline-2 outline-offset-2).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable 'jump' animations if prefers-reduced-motion is true.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
TAILWIND CONFIG: Update tailwind.config.js to include the specific Mario colors and extend font families.
LUCIDE ICONS: Use 'Pixel' styling for icons. Thick strokes, no rounded caps if possible.
BACKGROUND: Set the global body background to 'bg-sky-blue' (#5C94FC) to mimic the Level 1-1 sky.
CONTAINERS: All main content should be inside a white container with thick black borders to stand out against the blue sky.
THEME: Default to Light Mode (Sky Blue). Dark Mode can be 'Underground' (Black bg with Blue highlights).
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
